review_reference.registered_failure_shape: Conditional frontier includes forbidden-contact, orientation and timeout outcomes. One registered level5 example develops low forward gain, sustained tilt and rollover; an additional level4 timeout has long small-motion unloaded-foot behavior. They are different outcome/geometry examples, not one obligatory sequence.
unknowns: Exact contact surface and training cause are not established.
Selected video is not a population frequency sample.

review_reference.registered_failure_shape: Height OOD has forbidden-contact failures including examples without confirmed sustained tilt. The registered frame sequence shows low trunk posture with continued leg motion. Successes in the same cell/run remain a required counterexample.
unknowns: Trunk-to-surface clearance is not the recorded foot-point clearance.
No exact belly/edge collision point is asserted.

review_reference.registered_failure_shape: Medium includes failures that never complete recovery dwell and failures that complete it but finish unstable. Registered env19 latches at109 then becomes unstable and fails final planar speed; env23 is successful despite a later transient instability. Other falls remain in the cohort denominator.
unknowns: No per-foot force/placement measurement; do not infer exact step count or ankle/hip strategy.
Neither visual uprightness nor a completed dwell alone establishes task success.

review_reference.registered_failure_shape: Repeated stratum includes a registered episode that falls during the first recovery window, before the second planned push executes, plus successful multi-event episodes. Use observed/planned/censored windows and success controls separately.
unknowns: A first-push fall is not evidence of accumulation across two executed pushes.
Proposed reward causes/effects remain untrained hypotheses.
